summary: A delegated dismissal retried while the first one is still being written now gets the recorded answer, as a later retry already did, instead of a stale-fence error

replay.detail: No replay or recovery behavior changes; the same claims are written.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: No protocol or API change: a caller that sent an identical dismissal gets the answer it would have got a moment later, instead of a stale-fence error.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions; reverting the commit restores the earlier error.
